'''LBT-16''' was a [[BT-16 perimeter droid]] for sale at [[Jawa Traders]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. When it arrived it was a psychological mess, requiring a complete [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] to overcome its trauma. It was refurbished and in excellent physical condition as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="GG7" />
